request:
Source ticket: MAG-14 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-14/startend-battery-percentage

Please create the columns `start_battery_pct and end_battery_pct on the database table supercharger_sessions.`

Check if there is a way to know what's the start/end battery percentage . *Base on the API response* when fetching supercharger sessions data. Maybe based on the energy added? 

grill me about that

review.brief: Review RM27 tier 1 (telemetry) at commits cebadf2 + 3dbbe40 — read the DIFF, not the whole module. Validate: (1) R3/D3/D6 load-bearing — all five columns absent from UpsertSuperchargerSession INSERT, VALUES and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET, and T6.2/T6.2b would genuinely FAIL if added; (2) the migration matches the user-confirmed design gate exactly (5 nullable cols, CHECK 0..100, source CHECK IN user_verified/polled, NO new index) — any mismatch is a blocker finding; (3) D6 frozen snapshot never wired as a cache or refreshed anywhere; (4) tests assert design.md test-contract scenarios a/b/b2/c/d as AUTHORED UP FRONT, not what the code happens to do; (5) module boundary — telemetry imports only account+tesla public packages, pgtype confined to mapping.go, no internal/battery reference, no file outside internal/telemetry; (6) docs — AGENTS.md covers all five columns incl. the frozen-snapshot warning; (7) anti-gaming — no task/criterion weakened or deleted in tasks.md. Test-Execution-Policy (verbatim): Claude writes tests but never runs the suite — never go test ./..., make test, make test-with-db or make check. It MAY run go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make build, make vet, make bins, and the standalone guards. The owner runs the suite and reports results. SIGNAL PROVENANCE: go build, go vet, gofmt, make sqlc, openspec validate --strict and the V7 static R3 grep were ASSISTANT-run and green; `make test` was USER-run and reported passing by the owner. Judge test quality by READING the tests — do not run the suite yourself.

decisions.decision: Database design gate CONFIRMED — five nullable columns, all omitted from UpsertSuperchargerSession, no new index
decisions.why: Design, rationale and index plan were presented and iterated once (the _est snapshot pair was added at the user's request) before confirmation.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's unrequested proposal.md edit for internal coherence
decisions.why: Its 'three columns' language would have contradicted design.md after the revision. Mechanical, renegotiates nothing approved.

decisions.decision: Batched T1,T2,T3,T5,T7 into ONE serial worker instead of three dependency waves
decisions.why: Deps constrain order, not batching; one dispatch amortizes the doc-pack read. make sqlc still runs between this wave and T4.

decisions.decision: Downgraded T2/T3 from the worker-reported done to awaiting-user-verification; kept T5/T7 done
decisions.why: T2/T3 are guarded by T6 tests nobody has run. T5/T7 are comment/markdown only — build+vet verify them completely, no suite surface exists.

decisions.decision: Folded wave 1's mandatory suite-ask into wave 2's single ask
decisions.why: T6 authors this change's only tests. A suite run after wave 1 would verify no new assertion and cost a round trip; after wave 2 it verifies everything.

decisions.decision: Downgraded T4 from the worker-reported done to awaiting-user-verification
decisions.why: rowToSuperchargerSession is exercised by T6.4's reader round-trip, which nobody has run. Consistent with D4.

events.event: Dispatched telemetry worker (sonnet) to author artifacts. Artifacts-only scope — no implementation.

Design gate presented to user. Result: confirmed with one revision — add start/end_battery_pct_est as a frozen verification snapshot (roadmap R8). Worker re-dispatched via SendMessage to reuse context.

Artifacts revised and re-validated (openspec validate --strict: valid). CONTRACT NOTE: README.md was modified outside the worker's sandbox and not reported; excluded from this change's commits and left in the working tree for the user to triage.
Resumed at Step 5. Dispatched telemetry worker (sonnet) for wave 1: T1,T2,T3,T5,T7. Budget at dispatch: 5h 2%, ctx 8%.

Wave 1 complete (T1,T2,T3,T5,T7). Leader ran make sqlc: models.go was already byte-identical to sqlc output, query.sql.go was regenerated to pick up T3's comment. Verified UpsertSuperchargerSessionParams has zero battery fields and the reader row type has all five. go build/go vet green.

CONTRACT NOTE: internal/telemetry/db/models.go + query.sql.go carried sqlc-regenerated diffs before the wave-1 worker started and it did not report this until its final message. Leader re-ran make sqlc authoritatively, so current generated output is trustworthy regardless of provenance.
Wave 1 committed cebadf2. Dispatched telemetry worker (sonnet) for wave 2: T4 then T6. Budget at dispatch: 5h 9%, ctx 11%.

Wave 2 complete (T4,T6). Leader verified independently: go build/go vet green; V7 static R3 check returns 0 battery_pct matches inside the upsert query body; only internal/telemetry files touched; read T6.2 and confirmed it is a genuine regression guard (asserts IsPaid/updated_at DID advance, proving the conflict path ran, while the trio stayed 18/76/user_verified).

Wave 2 committed 3dbbe40. openspec validate --strict: valid (V11). Assistant-run signals complete: go build, go vet, gofmt, make sqlc, V7 static R3 grep. STOPPED at the Step 6 mandatory ask — the suite is the owner's to run; reviewer will not be dispatched until they report a pass.

USER VERIFICATION: the owner ran `make test` and reported it passing. Recorded as the owner's report, not the assistant's. T1,T2,T3,T4,T6 promoted awaiting-user-verification -> done; change status -> verified.
Reviewer telemetry-reviewer returned round 1 APPROVED, zero findings. Leader verified it wrote only the review block — review.brief and all tasks[] fields intact.

Archived via openspec archive -y; telemetry spec updated (2 requirements modified). Leader moved status verified -> archived WITHOUT ever writing reviewer-approved itself: the gate signal is review.status, set by the reviewer.
V1-V7,V9-V11 ticked at archive (V2 on the owner's reported make test pass). V8 left UNTICKED and annotated: the no-CREATE-INDEX half is confirmed, the EXPLAIN half was never run.
